_about: Field rules for dumppass.py (Wikipedia dump pass, the user 2026-11-16: economic, political, military, science, culture, anthropology, psychology, history). Regexes are case-insensitive and run on an article's own [[Category:]] names plus its {{Short description}}. 'strong' matches (infobox, title pattern, title list, strong_words) keep the article even if 'exclude' matches. People (a births/deaths category) need a 'people' match too. Tune on the part 1 trial; dumppass.py report shows what each rule kept and dropped.
